𝐏𝐫𝐢𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐋𝐚𝐛 𝐃𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐬 𝟏𝟏 𝐇𝐌𝐏𝐕 𝐂𝐚𝐬𝐞𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐇𝐲𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐝

Hyderabad sees a surge in respiratory infections as a private lab reports 11 Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases in Dec 2024, contradicting Telangana Health Dept's claims of no confirmed cases.
